symptom: A cracked-star-jar-only late-win-conversion PPO continuation preserved anchor alignment and passed e30/parent window no-regression, but still produced 0% 300s win rate on all three high-pressure maps. Standalone cracked-star-jar evaluation also remained 0% win rate with 220.1403s average survival, and split-policy 300s cracked-star-jar average survival stayed at 175.2584s.
root_cause: The constrained per-map continuation did not create a materially different late-state action surface on inherited parent states. Handoff distribution over 458 observations from 120s to 240s showed mean base-to-candidate KL 0.000541 and argmax agreement 1.0, so the candidate mostly preserved parent behavior without learning terminal conversion.
fix: Do not continue this exact single-map constrained continuation or keep tuning split thresholds. The next repair should train directly on parent late-state traces with explicit action-score separation and terminal-conversion objectives, while retaining required e30 and parent no-regression gates.
validation: ppo_training_report.json recorded anchor_validation_guard_passed, full_anchor_alignment.json recorded mean KL 0.105798 and argmax agreement 0.8286, anchor_drift_alignment.json recorded mean KL 0.019888 and argmax agreement 0.965, both required window regression reports passed, repair_probe_gate.json returned limited follow-up only, and split_failure_analysis_300s.json still recorded 9 failures across all high-pressure maps.
